title: Kissed Algerian Garlic Tagine
description: A comforting and flavorful Algerian dish made with garlic granules, double-rise-bread, and a hint of sweetness, perfect for a cozy evening meal. This recipe is a twist on the classic tagine, with the addition of crunchy double-rise-bread and paleo-friendly ingredients.

ingredients.name: double-rise-bread
ingredients.notes: gluten-free bread is highly recommended for this recipe

ingredients.name: honey
ingredients.notes: raw, unfiltered honey is recommended for this recipe

instructions: In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the chicken broth, honey, salt, and black pepper to the skillet, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Meanwhile, toast the slivered almonds in a small pan over medium heat, until fragrant and lightly browned.

To assemble the tagine, place a slice of double-rise-bread in the bottom of a baking dish. Spoon some of the onion-garlic mixture over the bread, followed by a sprinkle of garlic granules. Repeat this process two more times, ending with a layer of bread on top.
Drizzle the toasted almonds over the top of the tagine, then cover the dish with aluminum foil.
Bake the tagine in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, until the bread is golden brown and the filling is hot and bubbly.
Remove the foil and bake for an additional 5-10 minutes, until the top is lightly browned.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with additional almonds and a sprinkle of garlic granules if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
